highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with major font and lifecycle updates.
highlights_body: It rolls up variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, SKPathBuilder, explicit surface sampling, broader native assets, and corrected singleton ownership. This is a breaking release: review the API, font, stream, WebAssembly, and Vulkan migrations before upgrading from v3.

breaking.title: Legacy paint, font, sampling, and run-buffer APIs are compile errors
breaking.body: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs are removed from the reference surface. Move SKPaint text state to SKFont, use SKSamplingOptions instead of SKFilterQuality, use SKFontHinting, and replace run-buffer Get*Span methods with the Glyphs and Positions properties.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo moves to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update references to the correctly cased type; the old type no longer provides IEquatable, Equals, or equality operators.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only
breaking.body: Derived wrappers can no longer assign IgnorePublicDispose after construction. Set disposal protection through the appropriate constructor path instead.

breaking.title: Parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface
breaking.body: new SKFont() and assigning a null typeface now produce SKTypeface.Empty, so text measures to zero and draws nothing. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default or another explicit typeface, and use IsEmpty to detect an unset face.

breaking.title: SKPaint and missing-family typeface null semantics change
breaking.body: A new SKPaint exposes SKTypeface.Default instead of null, and SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns the default face when no family matches. Use IsEmpty for paint checks and SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when strict null-on-miss behavior is required.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) validates the 32-bit native range
breaking.body: The long overload is obsolete and now throws OverflowException for values outside Int32 instead of silently truncating them. Validate the offset and call Move(int).

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Ganesh Vulkan requires Vulkan 1.1
breaking.body: Creating a Ganesh context with Vulkan 1.0 can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the instance for Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the matching value; use another backend on 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: Vulkan backend interop layouts change
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative removes fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2. GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo also gains Components, so update manual layout assumptions.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.148.0.0
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll moves from assembly version 3.119.0.0 to 4.148.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks pinned to the 3.x assembly version.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine adds newer codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, color-aware filters, and the RF16 single-channel half-float color type.

bullets.lead: SKPathBuilder becomes the path construction API
bullets.detail: SKPathBuilder wraps Skia's immutable-path model, while existing SKPath mutation methods remain available with obsolete warnings for migration.
Same-milestone syncs correct SkRP optimizer accounting, improve SkRuntimeEffect thread safety, and reject malformed SkRegion data.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for variation axes, named instances, design coordinates, palette selection, and per-color overrides.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and stream-backed SKData
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData returns backing SKData when a stream can expose it without copying.

bullets.lead: Explicit sampling for surface and bitmap draws
bullets.detail: New overloads accept SKSamplingOptions for SKSurface.Draw, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap.

bullets.lead: New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs
bullets.detail: Adds SKDocument.CreateXps options, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and additional HDR color types.

bullets.lead: Pixel spans honor the actual row stride
bullets.detail: SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now calculate lengths and coordinates from RowBytes, returning correct pixels for non-square and shared-buffer subsets.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer depends on builder collection order
bullets.detail: Disposal avoids flushing a builder after finalization has begun, preventing a native crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches
bullets.detail: Reattached GL views retain their dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface that remains blank.
The projection assembly is packaged under both current and previous Windows target frameworks so .NET 9 applications can resolve it.

bullets.lead: Singleton initialization and ownership are corrected
bullets.detail: Process-wide wrappers initialize lazily without constructor cycles, no longer free shared native objects, and remain alive across native calls.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility checks run on first interop use
bullets.detail: The compatibility gate moves from module load to the SkiaApi type initializer, allowing applications to configure native-library resolution before the first call.
Native packages add linux-bionic x64 and arm64 assets plus tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 support.

bullets.lead: Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload
bullets.detail: Apple NuGet assets target 26.0 rather than 26.2, allowing consumers to build with any compatible Xcode 26 workload.
The packages retain Emscripten assets for .NET 8 and later and report a clear build error on unsupported .NET 6 and .NET 7 projects.
The bundled XML parser advances to 2.8.1 with upstream security hardening and updated entropy-source handling.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable fonts, typeface resolution, the SKPath finalizer fix, and singleton lifecycle work

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Advances Skia through m147 and adds SKPathBuilder, variable fonts, color font palettes, explicit surface sampling, managed typeface resolution, and checked 32-bit stream movement.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple workload compatibility.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Requires .NET 8 or later for WebAssembly native assets, adds HBColor and missing public wrappers, and refreshes bundled image, font, and compression libraries.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.summary: Promotes legacy SKPaint text and font APIs to compile errors, updates to Skia m148, fixes singleton ownership and pixel spans, and restores .NET 9 WinUI projection loading.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 updates the bundled shaping engine from 8.3.1.5 with improved OpenType shaping, CFF2 subsetting, and font-table handling, while adding variable-font, color-palette, and HBColor APIs.
